18.75% (Quad) |rewards = N/A |modifiers = [[Legacy]] |music-1 = '''Final Wave''' [[File:(Official) Tower Defense Simulator OST - Fallen Boss|center|250px|thumb]] }} ==Description== '''Legacy Fallen''', internally referred to as '''Insane''', is a mode exclusive to [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. It is an older version of [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode, more specifically mostly replicating the version before the 2nd of August 2024 without [[Enemies Beta]] applied, with some minor differences, like the income, certain enemy statistics or soundtracks. While the actual legacy [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode used to give cash on damage, with a shared cash of 25% of the damage dealt being given to all other players, this is not the case here. In the [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, it uses the new income system, though as the enemies have no set up cash values, they all give {{Money|5}} on death. Cash is only gained if an enemy is killed, or in some cases, damaged by a specific amount of health. Additionally, the amount gained is a set amount of cash, which is not always equal to the enemy's health. In solo, you receive 100% of the cash when an enemy is killed, or it is damaged enough. With each additional player, this decreases by 25%, which means that in a quad, you only get 25% of the cash. The cash distribution between players is based on how much damage they dealt. If a player has not dealt any damage, they will receive a percentage of the enemy's full cash upon its death or when it was damaged enough: *Duo: 12.5% *Trio: 16.7% *Quad: 18.75% On the condition that the resulting amount has a decimal, it gets rounded up or down depending on the decimal value. If it is at least 0.5, it gets rounded up. If it is less than 0.5, it gets rounded down. For example, the [[Abnormal]] gives {{Money|5}} when killed in solo, {{Money|3.75}} in duo, rounded up to {{Money|4}}, {{Money|2.5}} in trio, rounded up to {{Money|3}} and {{Money|1.25}} in quad, rounded down to {{Money|1}} between the players that damaged it. Players that did not damage it receive {{Money|0.625}} in duo, rounded up to {{Money|1}}, {{Money|0.835}} in trio, rounded up to {{Money|1}} and {{Money|0.9375}} in quad, rounded up to {{Money|1}}. ==Enemies== {| class="empty-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:80%; margin:1em auto" |[[File:Abnormal1.png|center|150px|link=Abnormal]] |[[File:Quick4.png|center|150px|link=Quick]] |[[File:HeavyFrostUpdate.png|center|150px|link=Heavy]] |[[File:AbnormalBossFrostUpdate.png|center|150px|link=Abnormal Boss]] |- |[[Abnormal]]

title: Casual Mode
wikitext_excerpt:
{{ModeTabs|Story = No}} {{ModeInfobox |title1 = {{Color|CasualMode}} |image1 = GraveDiggerEasyIcon.png |waves = 25 |level_requirement = None |starting_cash = {{Money|500}}
{{Money|600}} (Group Bonus) |time = 10:00 |rewards = {{Coins|450}}, {{Exp|90}} & {{TowerExp|50}} }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|For players who are looking for a casual experience.|Description in Elevators}} }} ==Description== '''Casual''' mode is one of the six main survival modes. The mode has 25 waves, and the final boss is [[Grave Digger]]. Cash is only gained if an enemy is killed, or in some cases, damaged by a specific amount of health. Additionally, the amount gained is a set amount of cash, which is not always equal to the enemy's health. It uses a slightly different method of distributing cash between players, as enemies split their cash between players, regardless of how much damage the player dealt to it. If, in a duo, one player does all the damage to an enemy, both players will receive 50% of the cash the enemy would normally give in solo. This means that in solo, you receive 100% of the cash when an enemy is killed, or it is damaged enough. With each additional player, this is reduced to 50% in duo, 33% in trio and 25% in quad. If it is a decimal, it gets rounded up or down depending on the decimal value. If it is at least 0.5, it gets rounded up. If it is less than 0.5, it gets rounded down. ==Rewards== The game calculates how many {{Coins|Coins}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 100% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 2x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplies any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts are additive. Some maps like [[Mason Arch]] can also increase all rewards by a specific amount. Regular {{Exp|}} boosts are multiplicative with other modifiers. Any rewards that end in a decimal point is rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal. Rewards are calculated as: {| class="tds-table pad-10" style="text-align: center; margin:1em auto" !Coins Reward !EXP Reward !Tower EXP Reward |- |{{Coins|400}} ÷ (1 + [(25 ÷ Current Wave) - 1]^1.3) + {{Coins|50}} (Triumph Bonus) |{{Exp|75}} ÷ (1 + [(25 ÷ Current Wave) - 1]) + {{Exp|15}} (Triumph Bonus) |{{TowerExp|20}} ÷ (1 + [(25 ÷ Current Wave) - 1]) + {{TowerExp|30}} (Triumph Bonus) |} Triumphing '''Casual''' mode can give out an additional reward, which can be a crate, consumable or ticket. They are meant to be guaranteed, though due to a bug this does not always happen. Additionally, items are sometimes not given out. These items are: *{{Color|Common}} (50%) **[[Grenade]] (1-2) **[[Flash Bang]] (1-2) **[[Molotov]] (1-2) **[[Easter Egg]] (1-2) *{{Color|Uncommon}} (30%) **{{TimeScaleTicket|Time Scale Ticket}} **{{ReviveTicket|Revive Ticket}} *{{Color|Rare}} (20%) **[[Low Grade Crate]] **{{SpinTicket|Spin Ticket}} **[[Barricade]] **[[Supply Drop]] **[[AirStrike]] **[[Ducky Squad]] ===Badges/Achievements=== There are [[badges]] and achievements that you can or could obtain when playing this mode, which may have additional rewards alongside them. These are: {{Badge |title = Defeat Grave Digger |description = Get ready to have your grave dug! |image = D11EasyBadge.png |obtainable = Yes }} {{Badge |title = Average Joe |description = Triumph in Casual mode |image = Achievement |obtainable = Yes |rewards = {{Coins|150}} }} ===Seasons=== During some [[Passes]], the '''Casual''' mode could give currency rewards which you used to progress through a season. {{Attr|Nimble}} (Variable) }} ==Description== The '''Corrupted Fallen''' is a quick enemy that appears in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode. It also appears in [[The Takeover Event]]. It is a stronger version of the [[Fallen]]. It has a decent amount of health and a rather fast speed. The '''Corrupted Fallen''' also has the [[Health Regen]] attribute, meaning it regenerates 2% of its max health every two seconds. The '''Corrupted Fallen''' can be spawned by the [[Fallen King]] with its ''Summon'' ability. The [[Awakened Fallen King]] was previously able to summon it using its ''Army of Chaos'' ability. ==Logbook Description== "''Corrupted Fallen were both the King's and Queen's personal servants. They stood up closest to her during the sacrifice and witnessed her final moments. The corruption crawls across their bodies, slowly consuming them as time moves on. It doesn't seem that they are bothered by this, but regular Fallen tend to stay away from them.''" ==Appearance== The '''Corrupted Fallen''' is a corrupted version of the [[Fallen]]. It has black skin. It wears a white blindfold and appears to be crying behind it. It has multiple blue spikes on its on its body. It has two arm-bands with chains attached to it. ==Strategy== *The '''Corrupted Fallen''' is quite a step-up compared to its non-corrupted counterpart, the [[Fallen]]. While not having much of a step-up in HP, it spawns with the [[Health Regen]] attribute. This means that it should not be left on low health. Instead, it should be dealt with as soon as possible. **Applying high DPS towers, like the [[Minigunner]], [[Engineer]], [[Accelerator]] and [[Turret]] can take it out with ease, as well as clearing out hordes of '''Corrupted Fallens'''. **The [[Commander]], [[DJ Booth]] and [[Mercenary Base]] can also be useful at boosting your towers. *Area of effect towers, like the [[Mortar]], [[Electroshocker]] or [[Rocketeer]] can be useful at clearing out the hordes of '''Corrupted Fallens''' that appear later on. *Because of its high speed, slowing towers such as the [[Cryomancer]], [[Tesla]] and [[Freezer]] can be used to negate their speed. Though since the '''Corrupted Fallen''' does not have any immunities, any tower can be used to slow it down. *If any '''Corrupted Fallens''' leak, the [[Military Base]] can be used to catch any off-guard. Though long-ranged towers such as the [[Ranger]] can also be utilized. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} CorruptedFallenRun.gif|Running animation (2 August 2024 – Present) CorruptedFallenRun2.gif|Running animation (2 August 2024 – Present) CorruptedFallenStun.gif|Stun animation (2 Au

{{ModeTabs|Story = No}} {{ModeInfobox |title1 = {{Color|EasyMode|Easy}} |image1 = EasyReworkIcon.png |waves = 20 |level_requirement = None |starting_cash = {{Money|500}}
{{Money|600}} (Group Bonus) |time = 7:00 |rewards = {{Coins|300}}, {{Exp|50}} & {{TowerExp|25}} }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|For players who are new to the game or want a more relaxed experience.|Description in Elevators}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Easy''' mode, formerly '''Normal''' and '''Beginner's''' mode, is one of the six main Survival modes. '''Easy''' mode has 20 waves. It is not named after its final boss, the [[Brute]]. Cash is only gained if an enemy is killed, or in some cases, damaged by a specific amount of health. Additionally, the amount gained is a set amount of cash, which is not always equal to the enemy's health. It uses a slightly different method of distributing cash between players, as enemies split their cash between players, regardless of how much damage the player dealt to it. If, in a duo, one player does all the damage to an enemy, both players will receive 50% of the cash the enemy would normally give in solo. This means that in solo, you receive 100% of the cash when an enemy is killed, or it is damaged enough. With each additional player, this is reduced to 50% in duo, 33% in trio and 25% in quad. If it is a decimal, it gets rounded up or down depending on the decimal value. If it is at least 0.5, it gets rounded up. If it is less than 0.5, it gets rounded down. ==Rewards== ''For former rewards, see this mode's [[Easy Mode/Rewards|Rewards]] page.'' The game calculates how many {{Coins|Coins}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 100% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 2x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplies any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts are additive. Some maps like [[Mason Arch]] can also increase all rewards by a specific amount. Regular {{Exp|}} boosts are multiplicative with other modifiers. Any rewards that end in a decimal point is rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal. Currently, rewards are calculated as: {| class="tds-table pad-10" style="text-align: center; margin:1em auto" !Coins Reward !EXP Reward !Tower EXP Reward |- |{{Coins|250}} ÷ (1 + [(20 ÷ Current Wave) - 1]^1.3) + {{Coins|50}} (Triumph Only) |{{Exp|50}} ÷ (1 + [(20 ÷ Current Wave) - 1]) |{{TowerExp|10}} ÷ (1 + [(25 ÷ Current Wave) - 1]) + {{TowerExp|15}} (Triumph Bonus) |} Triumphing '''Easy''' mode can give out an additional reward, which can be a crate, consumable or ticket. They are meant to be guaranteed, though due to a bug this does not always happen. Additionally, items are sometimes not given out. These items are: *{{Color|Common}} (50%) **[[Grenade]] (1-2) **[[Flash Bang]] (1-2) **[[Molotov]] (1-2) **[[Easter Egg]] (1-2) *{{Color|Uncommon}} (30%) **{{TimeScaleTicket|Time Scale Ticket}} **{{ReviveTicket|Revive Ticket}} *{{Color|Rare}} (20%) **[[Low Grade Crate]] **{{SpinTicket|Spin Ticket}} **[[Barricade]] **[[Supply Drop]] **[[Ducky Squad]] ===Badges/Achievements=== There are [[badges]] and achievements that you can or could obtain when playing this mode, which may have additional rewards alongside them. These are: {{Badge |title = Defeated the Brute |description = Defeat the Brute in Easy mode. |image = Aug25EasyBadge.png |obtainable = Yes }} {{Badge |title = Recruit |description = Triumph in Easy mode |image = Achievement |obtainable = Yes |rewards = {{Coins|100}} }} {{Badge |title = Defeat Grave Digger |description = Get ready to have your grave dug! |image = D11EasyBadge.png |obtainable = No }} ===Seasons=== During some [[Passes]], the '''Normal''' mode could give currency rewards that you used to progress through a season.
